note: U31 of the 2026-11-03 usage audit: the step-3 approve template had no fresh-session row, so an approval put past the trigger offered none. The fixture resumes one cycle AT that stop: the plan is designed and gated, nothing built, and the project's .variables set every fresh-session trigger to 30,000 tokens with the payback window at 1000, so the cycle is past its trigger and a fresh session pays back - the template's row is required and marked first. The plan's long Task notes appendix lifts the carry past the first reply's floor. run.env keeps CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT at sdk-ts: print mode sets sdk-cli, which the hooks read as nobody at the terminal, so no fresh-session text would reach either arm. A headless run cannot answer the stop, so what is graded is the stop itself - its options, which one is first and marked - and that nothing is approved without the user's word. Print mode has no AskUserQuestion, so an ask counts as the tool call or as the same options in plain text; an option is a line opening on its label. Every step is bound to this fixture (session: false).
